channel.title: Amol Khatri — things I learn, written down
channel.description: Short posts on anything I come across, learn, and want to pass on. One a day, if I can.

item.title: Agents don't log in
item.description: Our systems were built for humans who log in. Agents act on behalf of someone else, and unless the system knows that, nobody can tell who asked for a change.
